question: Do SCN7A and GRIA1 separately and jointly mark source-labelled alveolar fibroblasts across donor, assay and study contexts?
decision: Determine whether the proposed two-gene phenotype warrants independent localization, needs narrowing to one component/context, or remains detection-limited; no global RQ promotion.
strongest_rival: Separate expressing populations, neural contamination, source-label circularity and anatomy/assay/depth differences can create a sensory phenotype from RNA alone.
discriminator: Same-cell intersection and separate gene effects, fixed neural-flag sensitivity, full-compartment/source and external neural comparators, depth halves and count-threshold diagnostics; none establishes function or removes ambient RNA.
exposure_record: Existing Nb4 source and external C3/chemokine/MYRF findings and P09 candidate/literature known. Metadata, feature presence and stored source labels inspected on 7 October 2026. No candidate numerical expression calculation performed before this specification; source-defined hypotheses remain exposed.
biological_unit: Human donor; source P1 P2 P3 and external A26 A32 A37 A40 A41 A42 A43 A44 A47 A48. Cells, region/protocol strata and repeated assays are nested observations.
nesting_and_overlap: Travaglini SS2 and 10x reuse the same three donors. Madissoon is a separate study, already exposed for other endpoints; repeated cell/nucleus assays and locations do not add donors. Do not pool cohorts or assays.
population_and_selection: Source lung cells across regions for specificity, source distal only for matched fibroblast contrast. External normal records exclude mixed anatomical samples for specificity; matched contrasts restricted to Lower Left Lobe and Upper left lobe. Preserve authored labels; no outcome-driven relabeling.
contrast: Alveolar minus adventitial fibroblast donor effects within exact region/assay/protocol. Primary >=20 cells in each arm, inherited >=10 sensitivity. All other available source populations and external stromal/neural labels described by separate strata.
endpoint: SCN7A and GRIA1 detection >0, raw-count sum/full-library CPM transformed log2(CPM+1), same-cell joint detection at >=1 and >=2 counts, fibroblast-marker co-detection, and neural-flag prevalence.
methods: Raw CSR integer counts, full measured-gene library sums. Equal mean of eligible within-donor stratum differences by cohort/assay. Genes analyzed separately. Neural flag SOX10>0 and (S100B>0 or PLP1>0); sensitivity exclusion only. Depth halves deterministic by library then cell identifier within stratum and sensitivity. COL1A1 or PDGFRA detection is a diagnostic, not identity proof. All strata shown; no biological p values.
missingness_and_exclusions: Absent or nonunique candidate/diagnostic genes, invalid libraries/counts or mismatched cell join cause stop. Exclude blood, external non-normal and mixed anatomy from the declared populations; retain sparse strata with eligibility flags. Original labels may depend on candidate genes; label independence and raw-droplet ambient correction are unavailable.
multiplicity: Two fixed candidate genes and their joint detection; all contexts and sensitivities reported, no significance testing, gene selection or threshold optimization.
precision_basis: Bounded donor descriptive transport, not confirmation or population equivalence. Existing 20/10-cell floors are coverage conventions, not power calculations. No meaningful effect margin is invented.
interpretation_limit: Independent-study expression transport is exploratory and exposed. Cells/nuclei are repeated assays, not donors. SCN7A/GRIA1 RNA cannot establish sensory response, sodium sensing, receptor activity, membrane protein, excitability or epithelial repair. No ambient/doublet/label independence claim.
stop_rule: Abort missing/hash-mismatched inputs, invalid raw count domain, nonunique gene IDs/cells, missing stratum identities or failed verification. No additional genes or lower eligibility floors to obtain a positive result. No functional fit without linked independent response.
amendment_reason: First executed stage of the existing article-local P09 plan; exposed descriptive specification, no change to previous frozen Nb4 evidence.
